prompt: Read https://github.com/jjyr/pot/blob/main/docs/install-with-agent.md and help me install and configure Pot on this computer.
mac:
mise run prepare
mise run build
mise run open
linux:
sudo apt install build-essential pkg-config binutils libgtk-3-dev libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev dbus-user-session bubblewrap socat xvfb xauth
POT_APP_VERSION=0.1.0 POT_BUILD_REVISION=local mise exec -- python scripts/build-desktop --platform linux-amd64 --output .local/go/dist
cd .local/go/dist
sha256sum -c pot-desktop_0.1.0_linux_amd64.deb.sha256
sudo apt install ./pot-desktop_0.1.0_linux_amd64.deb
pot-desktop
docker:
docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 --load \
  --build-arg POT_APP_VERSION=0.1.0 \
  --build-arg POT_BUILD_REVISION="$(git rev-parse HEAD)" \
  -t pot-server:local .
docker compose -f docker/compose.yaml up -d --no-build
docker compose -f docker/compose.yaml exec pot pot access -browser-root /home/pot/.pot-web token
server:
mise run prepare
mise run build:go
.local/go/bin/pot serve -root "$HOME/.pot-node" -ui 127.0.0.1:17703
# {anotherTerminal}
.local/go/bin/pot access -root "$HOME/.pot-node" token
